scheme_name: Matritva, Shishu Evam Baalika Madad Yojana
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh
Beneficiary must be a registered construction worker
Benefits are provided only for the first two deliveries of the worker
Child benefits apply to the first girl child (or first legally adopted girl child in childless families) and to a second girl child only if both first and second children are girls
All girl children in the first two deliveries are eligible if more than one girl is born
Birth of the girl child must be registered
The girl must remain unmarried until age 18 to receive the fixed deposit benefit
Benefits will not be provided if the recipient is already receiving another similar government scheme
benefits_summary: The scheme offers cash and wage‑based maternity benefits to construction‑worker women (and a lump‑sum to their male spouses) and provides financial assistance for newborn children, with higher amounts for daughters and disabled children.
